given: A SKU's stock record carries a tracking code
when: The team member views that SKU's detail
then: The record's tracking code is displayed alongside its location detail

independence.rationale: AC1/AC2 assert which locations and which SKU's records appear; AC3 asserts a distinct field, the tracking code, is shown for a record. A build could list the correct locations and quantities (AC1/AC2 green) while omitting the tracking code column entirely (AC3 red).
